Not to be confused with Rainbow, a radio. Also not to be confused with Rainbow Gun (Godly), a godly gun Rainbow is a rare gun that is obtainable by unboxing it from Mystery Box 1 or through trading. The whole revolver is made up of all the colors of the rainbow, hence the name. It has a partner knife under the same name. This is one of the few guns added alongside the Season 1 update.

Arctic is a legendary gun that was originally obtainable by purchasing the 19th tier in the Battle Pass during the 2022 Christmas Event. It is now only obtainable through trading as the event has since ended. The gun uses the default gun mesh. It has a grey body, frame, barrel and trigger, with bright blue cracks along it. It has a partner knife under the same name. It was designed by IDontHaveAUse.
